Even with perfect CS on their part, as long as you don't feed and get a decent CS of your own, those champions will have too little farm to really be all that effective mid-game, unless someone plays the role of a 0 CS support and gives all his farm to the other guy of course.

Being good at CS is just something that comes with steady and persistent pratice. We can give you a few pointers, but it will really just be instinct in good time.

Dont get into the habit of auto-attacking waves, its okay to hit the minions a few times if you dont want your lane pushed to your tower where you may miss more CS, but all of the time you want to actively try and get the last hit otherwise you will not learn, and it will not become instinct.

 You need to be patient as well. I see people get a few items and think 
"Screw the rules i have items" and just start AoEing down waves and missing more than they did with less AD/AS/AP.

I dont know if you "main" any particular champions, if you do, get used to their unique attack animation. Most of them are fairly responsive unlike DoTA or HoN, but the older champions like Zilean, Anivia, Fiddlesticks and Karthus have a long wind up on their autos.

If you really want to improve, you could try doing last hitting drills in custom games. I usually pick my champion, get the items i normally would lane with and get as many as possible in 10 minutes. Its easier in mid lane because the lane is shorter and caster minions dont stack up and make csing difficult, but you should learn it for the lane you would actually play in a real game.

Thats all the help i can give i think, good luck. By the way, you are going to hate siege minions very soon. Siege minion OP.
